jordi (Product): Heads-up: small preview of Dedicated H200-Max pools in africa-south-1 (Johannesburg) next week. Go-live: 2026-05-14 07:00 UTC. This is Dedicated-only preview for select customers. :south_africa:
ameer (Eng-Platform): Initial capacity tiny: 10 GPUs (2 nodes). Reservations required for guaranteed access. Console label: `dedicated.h200-max.preview.africa-south-1`.
zola (Eng-SRE): Infra deploy scheduled, tags added: h200-max-africa-preview. No control-plane downtime expected. infra-bot will post change details.
infra-bot: Scheduled change: ADD_POOL africa-south-1 h200-max count=2 change_id=CHG-20260514-5540 eta=2026-05-14T07:00:00Z
ameer (Eng-Platform): Reservation CLI example:
redwood reserve --region=africa-south-1 --gpu-type=h200-max --count=1 --term=monthly
API hint: use `gpu_type=h200-max` and `preview=true`. Older clients sending `h200` will map to previous variant.
jordi (Product): Pricing: preview premium +18% over H200 baseline. Billing tag: `dedicated.h200-max.preview`. No SLA for preview.
ops-neha: Reservation policy for preview: min term 1 month; 7-day notice for downsizes; priority given to existing Enterprise Dedicated contracts. DM if exception needed.
zola (Eng-SRE): Routing & fallback: requests specifying `gpu_type=h200-max` route to preview pool. If exhausted, behavior depends on flags: `allow_queue=true` -> queued; otherwise you get `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY`. Recommend client fallback `fallback_gpu_types=["h200","a100"]` and exponential backoff.
ameer (Eng-Platform): Known preview limits: quantization profiles experimental; max default seq len 12k; no cross-zone live migration. Monitor Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> africa-south-1 -> h200-max.
jordi (Product): Action items: 1) Teams wanting access, submit reservation by 2026-05-12 23:59 UTC. 2) Add `gpu_type=h200-max` to test flags and include fallback list. 3) Report anomalies to #eng-platform with `h200-max` tag.
ceo-emma: Thanks team! Great to expand Dedicated coverage to Africa. We'll share a short exec note after 48h with utilization and early feedback. :clap:
